adjustments.description: Settlement of a commercial dispute. Non-recurring.
adjustments.management_rationale: Settlement of commercial dispute - non-recurring. Management advises FY2023, FY2024, and FY2025 settlements relate to separate matters.
adjustments.reasoning: The identical $2,100,000 legal settlement adjustment appears in each of FY2023 (ADJ-001), FY2024 (ADJ-002), and FY2025 (ADJ-003). Board minutes (DOC-09, Item 7) independently confirm this is a series: the CFO reported 'the third annual settlement under the ongoing series of commercial disputes with former channel partners had been concluded at $2.1M, consistent with the prior two years.' The Board asked whether provision should be made for a further settlement in FY2026. This constitutes affirmative independent evidence that the settlement is recurring in nature. Management's classification as non-recurring is directly contradicted by the board-level characterisation of an 'ongoing series.' The adjustment is Rejected as a recurring cost that should remain in reported EBITDA.

adjustments.category: Pro-forma full-year effect of new logos
adjustments.description: Annualising the FY2025 in-year contribution of logos won during the year.
adjustments.management_rationale: Annualising FY2025 new bookings to reflect full-year run-rate contribution.
adjustments.reasoning: Pro-forma annualisation of new logos is a recognised but inherently forward-looking QoE adjustment. Structured data confirms 20 new logos (customers with first_order_date in 2025) with total actual FY2025 revenue of $1,878,956. The data-derived annualisation gap (implied full-year revenue minus actual FY2025 revenue) is $1,428,966, which is $221,034 less than management's claimed $1,650,000. The structured data provides partial support for the concept of an annualisation uplift, but the management amount exceeds the data-supported figure. Furthermore, pro-forma annualisation adjustments are inherently forward-looking and assume that new logos will maintain their run-rate, which is not guaranteed. The annualisation methodology used by management (which may differ from the simple monthly run-rate extrapolation applied to invoice data) cannot be independently verified without the underlying model. Because the supportable amount differs from the management amount and the methodology cannot be independently confirmed, the accepted amount cannot be precisely quantified. Verdict is Challenged with accepted_amount_usd = null.

sql_evidence.purpose: ADJ-010 annualisation gap calculation: data-supported vs management claimed
sql_evidence.sql_query: SELECT SUM(actual_fy2025_revenue) AS total_actual_revenue, SUM(implied_annualised_revenue) AS total_implied_annualised, SUM(annualisation_gap) AS total_annualisation_gap, COUNT(*) AS new_logo_count FROM (SELECT c.customer_id, SUM(fi.invoice_amount_usd) AS actual_fy2025_revenue, (12 - MONTH(c.first_order_date) + 1) AS months_active, (SUM(fi.invoice_amount_usd) / (12 - MONTH(c.first_order_date) + 1)) * 12 AS implied_annualised_revenue, ((SUM(fi.invoice_amount_usd) / (12 - MONTH(c.first_order_date) + 1)) * 12) - SUM(fi.invoice_amount_usd) AS annualisation_gap FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer c ON fi.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE YEAR(fi.invoice_date) = 2025 AND YEAR(c.first_order_date) = 2025 GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_order_date) sub
sql_evidence.result_summary: 20 new logos. Total actual FY2025 revenue: $1,878,956. Data-derived annualisation gap: $1,428,966. Management claimed: $1,650,000. Excess over data-supported: $221,034.

sql_evidence.result_summary: No enterprise value, purchase price, or transaction valuation found in mgmt_claim table.

sql_evidence.purpose: ADJ-010 management vs data-supported amount comparison
sql_evidence.sql_query: SELECT 1650000 AS mgmt_claimed_annualisation, 1428966 AS data_supported_annualisation_gap, 1650000 - 1428966 AS unsupported_excess, ROUND(1428966.0 / 1650000.0, 4) AS support_ratio
sql_evidence.result_summary: Management claimed: $1,650,000. Data-supported gap: $1,428,966. Unsupported excess: $221,034. Support ratio: 0.8660 (86.6% of management amount supported by data-derived methodology).

unresolved_items.description: Team Adjusted EBITDA is null. Five FY2025 adjustments (ADJ-004, ADJ-006, ADJ-007, ADJ-009, ADJ-010) have Challenged status with accepted_amount_usd = null due to insufficient independent evidence to quantify the retained amount. Two adjustments (ADJ-003, ADJ-005) are Rejected. No accepted adjustments exist. Team EBITDA cannot be calculated as a precise figure.
unresolved_items.resolution_required: Independent evidence for each Challenged adjustment is required to quantify accepted amounts and calculate Team Adjusted EBITDA.
unresolved_items.impact: HIGH - prevents precise Team Adjusted EBITDA and earnings challenge calculation

unresolved_items.description: Enterprise Value not found in any authoritative supplied deal input or document. Implied EBITDA multiples cannot be calculated.
unresolved_items.resolution_required: Enterprise Value must be explicitly stated in an authoritative deal document or structured source.

unresolved_items.description: ADJ-008 (FY2024, $180,000 aborted refinancing costs) is present in structured data but absent from the management QoE schedule. Its treatment in the FY2024 adjusted EBITDA is unclear.
unresolved_items.resolution_required: Clarification from management on whether ADJ-008 was applied in FY2024 adjusted EBITDA and why it is absent from the QoE schedule.
unresolved_items.impact: LOW - FY2024 period, not directly affecting FY2025 team EBITDA

unresolved_items.description: Zero invoice lines exist for Legacy product family (PRD-016, PRD-017) despite these products existing in dim_product. It is unclear whether Legacy product revenue/costs are recorded in a separate system not reflected in the structured data, or whether the products are genuinely inactive.
unresolved_items.resolution_required: Legacy product P&L or cost allocation data required to verify ADJ-007.

unresolved_items.description: Sep-2025 third-party compensation benchmark referenced in ADJ-004 is not in the data room. Without this document, the $1,250,000 owner compensation normalisation cannot be independently verified.
unresolved_items.resolution_required: Third-party compensation benchmark and founder payroll records required.

data_quality.description: Legacy product family (PRD-016, PRD-017) exists in dim_product but has zero invoice lines in fact_invoice_line across all years. This may indicate data completeness issues for legacy/perpetual products or that these products are genuinely inactive in the billing system.
data_quality.impact: Prevents independent verification of ADJ-007 (Discontinued product line, $540,000).

data_quality.description: No payroll, HR, compensation, or legal cost tables exist in the structured schema. This prevents independent verification of ADJ-004 (owner compensation), ADJ-005 (headcount savings), ADJ-009 (recruitment fees), and ADJ-003 (legal settlement amounts).
data_quality.impact: Multiple adjustments cannot be independently quantified from structured data alone.

data_quality.description: ADJ-008 source_doc_ref points to vdr/QoE_Adjustment_Schedule_Mgmt.md but the document does not list ADJ-008. Source reference appears incorrect or the document was updated after the structured data was populated.
data_quality.impact: Minor - FY2024 period item. Creates inconsistency between structured data and document.
